name: Worktree-isolated parallel build with an empty-index guard and a recorded downgrade
description: Blueprint 39 of 96 (BP-IMP-02). FLAGSHIP. The ISOLATION SUBSTRATE that mutating fan-outs run inside, promoted from a measured 2.7% exception (9 of 329 executed workflows) to the default. Worktrees are PRE-CREATED before any unit starts (pre-creation removes the creation race), each from an explicit base_ref rather than whatever HEAD happens to be; integration is serial; and the empty-index trap - a scoped add in a fresh worktree staging thousands of deletions - is checked before any commit. A unit that cannot get a worktree is serialised into the main tree with scoped adds AND that downgrade is written down.

units.description: The mutating units that each need their own tree

repo.description: Repository root. Windows-style drive paths only for PATH arguments - a POSIX /c/... path is silently mangled by MSYS.

base_ref.description: EXPLICIT base for every worktree branch. Never HEAD - HEAD drifts while the fan-out runs.

encrypted_repo.description: git-crypt plus worktrees is a known interop hazard; when true the provisioner routes through the gitcrypt-worktree path

disk_budget_gb.description: Above this projected footprint the fan-out is narrowed rather than started

provisioner.description: Creates and destroys worktrees; asserts the target repository before any write and never touches unit content

integrator.description: Merges the per-unit branches back SERIALLY, one at a time, checking the staged surface of each

owner.description: Decides whether the disk cost of default isolation is acceptable at this fan-out width

stages.title: S0 PRE-CREATE every worktree before any unit starts - pre-creation removes the creation race

work_unit.title: Pre-create one worktree per mutating unit from an explicit base_ref, with content-preserving teardown planned up front
work_unit.question_or_target: Create N worktrees in ONE serial pass before any unit runs, each on a branch cut from the declared base_ref (never HEAD), each asserted to live under the declared repository, and record the teardown plan at creation time so an abandoned run cannot leak trees.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: provisioning errors are silent and expensive; do not downgrade this step

work_unit.evidence_requirement: `git worktree list --porcelain` output showing N trees, each branch's merge-base equal to the declared base_ref commit, and each path resolving under the declared repo root - all three re-runnable
tests_required: a worktree whose branch was cut from a moving HEAD instead of base_ref must be rejected by the merge-base check
a path outside the declared repo root must be refused BEFORE creation, not cleaned up afterwards
both-states control: with git-crypt enabled the provisioner must take the gitcrypt-worktree path and the plain path must FAIL on the same repo
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: an independent reviewer who re-lists the worktrees and re-derives each merge-base rather than reading the manifest
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:IMP-0446 emitted only when worktree-manifest.json lists exactly one live tree per unit, every merge-base equals base_ref, and every path is drive-absolute under the declared repo; otherwise FAILED:IMP-0446 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: a second creation failure for the same unit routes to the recorded serial downgrade rather than a third attempt

stages.title: Assert the target repository and path shape BEFORE any unit writes
Narrow the fan-out rather than exhaust the disk
S1 RUN units concurrently, each inside its own tree, each delegating to the quality loop

body.title: Delegate the four-phase quality loop into this unit's tree
S1b FALLBACK - no worktree available: serialise into the main tree with scoped adds and RECORD the downgrade

stages.title: Hard barrier: nothing integrates until every unit is terminal
`git add -A` in a shared tree sweeps a sibling's work - it is denied, and the denial is checked
A scoped add in a FRESH tree can stage thousands of deletions - catch it before the commit
S2 INTEGRATE one branch at a time, re-checking the staged surface of each
Prove no commit carries another unit's files and no sibling work was lost
S3 CLEAN UP - teardown must be content-preserving and must actually run
OWNER-DECISION: make isolation the hard default at 40+ agents, given the measured disk and setup cost?
stages.prompt: Measured disk footprint and setup wall-clock for this run are attached. Make worktree isolation the hard default for every mutating fan-out, keep it opt-in, or cap it at a fan-out width?

impact.blast_radius: N worktrees plus N branches under the declared repo; the isolation itself is what bounds the blast radius of the units running inside it

worked_example.scenario: Two concurrent units in one repo; unit A runs `git add -A` and commits while unit B has uncommitted work.
worked_example.shared_tree_outcome: unit A's broad add stages unit B's in-progress files; A commits them; B's later commit is empty or conflicting and B's work is silently attributed to A
worked_example.isolated_outcome: A and B hold separate indexes, so A's add cannot see B's files; broad-add-gate additionally fails A because broad_add_all_invocations > 0
worked_example.empty_index_control: unit C's worktree is fresh and its scoped `git add src/` stages 6,013 DELETIONS because the index is empty; empty-index-gate fails on staged_deletions > 0 before any commit exists
worked_example.downgrade_control: unit D's worktree creation fails twice (disk); the pivot routes D to serial-downgrade, which writes downgrade-record.json - the run is not silently less safe than it claims
worked_example.gitcrypt_control: with encrypted_repo=true the plain provisioning path must FAIL and the gitcrypt-worktree path must succeed; a provisioner that passes on both is not detecting the hazard

x_extensions.distinctive_mechanism: pre-creation before any unit starts, an explicit base_ref merge-base assertion, the empty-index staged-deletions guard, and a RECORDED downgrade when isolation is unavailable
contraindications: NOT for read-only fan-outs - pure overhead, no contamination to prevent
NOT where git-crypt and worktrees are combined without the gitcrypt-worktree path (known interop hazard)
NOT when disk is constrained below the projected footprint - narrow the fan-out instead
x_extensions.not_a_duplicate_because: BP-PLN-02 DECIDES which units may run in parallel; this is the substrate they run inside, and it delegates the quality loop rather than reimplementing it.
